paper.title_en: Zero-damped modes of near-extremal Reissner--Nordström black holes from exact WKB
paper.abstract_en: The late-time ringdown dynamics of near-extremal black holes (BHs) are expected to be dominated by zero-damped modes (ZDMs), whose decay rates are parametrically suppressed relative to those of ordinary quasinormal modes. In this paper, we demonstrate that exact WKB methods provide an exceptionally powerful framework for analyzing the ZDM spectrum of near-extremal Reissner--Nordström (RN) BHs. Focusing on massless, neutral scalar modes propagating on an RN background, we present the full Stokes geometry derived from the radial eigenvalue problem and establish the corresponding exact quantization condition (EQC). Our analytic computation of the Voros symbols entering the EQC achieves higher-order accuracy for the ZDM spectrum compared to previous studies and is systematically improvable. Ergo, this work serves as a proof of concept for investigations of ZDM spectra of other systems using exact WKB methods.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文使用精确WKB方法研究近极端RN黑洞的零阻尼模式，属于黑洞物理的前沿理论工作，具有较高的理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 用精确WKB方法研究近极端Reissner-Nordström黑洞的零阻尼模式
decision.abstract_zh: 近极端黑洞的晚期振铃动力学预计由零阻尼模式（ZDMs）主导，其衰减率相对于普通准正则模式被参数化地抑制。在本文中，我们证明精确WKB方法为分析近极端Reissner-Nordström (RN)黑洞的ZDM谱提供了一个非常强大的框架。着眼于在RN背景上传播的无质量、中性标量模式，我们从径向本征值问题出发给出了完整的Stokes几何，并建立了相应的精确量子化条件（EQC）。我们对进入EQC的Voros符号的解析计算，与之前的研究相比，实现了ZDM谱的高阶精度，并且是系统可改进的。因此，这项工作为使用精确WKB方法研究其他系统的ZDM谱提供了一个概念验证。
